objective: Define the first real run boundary that may prove a Verilator-facing native parser path can hand reviewed metadata to the sidecar launcher, without executing that run in this gate.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The accepted fixture proves only metadata readiness. A later run may still fail before sidecar launcher entry, during a sidecar stage, or during coverage-output compare, so those failure classes must remain distinct.
reason: the previous review accepted define_direct_launch_handoff_fixture only as non-executing readiness metadata
the exact reviewed handoff authority is now required before the fixture reports handoff readiness
the next useful step is to define what a real handoff run must prove before performing it
coverage_output_equivalence remains the only scoped correctness policy

artifacts: raw state dumps used by compare

failure_class_boundary.process_parse_failure: the Verilator-facing process rejects or fails before the expanded accelerator options are accepted
failure_class_boundary.missing_explicit_sidecar_context: native parser output exists but target/template/shape/source context is missing or ambiguous
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_authority_failure: reviewed handoff or stage authority is absent or mismatched for pulp_ita_mha 64x1
failure_class_boundary.direct_launch_handoff_failure: handoff metadata exists, but the future run does not enter the sidecar launcher from the native path
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_stage_failure: the sidecar launcher is reached, but a scoped build/run stage fails before compare
failure_class_boundary.compare_failure: coverage_output_equivalence compare runs and records a mismatch
failure_class_boundary.timing_claim_without_measurement: timing or speedup is claimed without a separate timing gate

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_direct_launch_handoff_run_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether the future run boundary is narrow enough for a first direct-launch handoff attempt
whether the boundary correctly distinguishes handoff failure, sidecar stage failure, and compare failure
whether generated reports and artifacts remain noncanonical
whether the boundary keeps timing, arbitrary filelists, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI changes, raw-state equality, and production throughput out of scope

non_claims: reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
